navigationSource.warning: Archive contains later changes. Bounded assembly corroborates the selected original3.58f rules.

analysis: Ordinary bounded LLVM disassembly; no original Windows execution or binary upload. Earlier REA evidence remains retained; Hopper bridge was unavailable.

observations.fact: Original hero interaction table is indexed by hero number0..155, independently of whether the hero is currently on the map.
D/E select the player disabled byte; S/R assign all eight bytes; they do not delete the hero or its script trigger.
H uses the two-byte per-hero hint index through Apply.
Native interaction disabled lookup reads the selected hero/player byte.
When the selected square is the hero, hint uses that hero table. A zero hero hint returns no custom hint immediately instead of falling through to coordinate object text.

implementation: Map-local serialized hero access mask and live z hint reference, keyed by original hero identity. Native hero exchange/battle is gated through the existing source visit completion path.
HO:S/R/D/E use the previously tested access-mask primitive; H accepts local z references and index query/reset.
Mobile hints reuse the stable existing native text presentation, including scroll and a single exit. No new panel or polling UI is introduced.
limitations: Native control proves friendly hero exchange suppression/restoration, not all hostile battle branches.
External hint tables above1000 remain unadmitted; these original campaigns use local z408.
An unchanged privately admitted original scenario still stops during initialization with unsupported host work remaining. The full campaign registry stays disabled.
